notes.title: EarlyAccess_2.7.8 – Earth Online Hotfix
notes.content: -Fix Earth Online issue where Bing maps API was no longer working.

notes.title: 🗺️ Earth Online Update – Version 2.7.7 (Steam Only)
notes.content:
[b]-Earth Online map selection is now available in-game![/b]
 You no longer need to end your session to change global locations—explore the world on the fly.
[b]-Real-time multiplayer across the globe.[/b]
 See your friends anywhere on the planet and jump to new locations instantly during a multiplayer session.
[b]-Improved Map Selection UI.[/b]
 Maps are now clearly labeled as either “Default Maps” or “Earth Online” to highlight the difference between local and streamed environments.
[b]-Major architecture overhaul.[/b]
 This update includes significant backend changes to Earth Online—please expect some bugs and report any issues on our Discord!

notes.title: Update EarlyAccess_2.6.6 - (Steam Only)
notes.content:
-Make “Fetch Nearby Sites” search all sites, not just detailed sites. 
-Make Nearby Site buttons clickable so the cursor goes to the site’s coordinates when clicked.
-Clear Nearby Sites once you leave “Browse Earth”.

notes.title: Update EarlyAccess_2.6.5 - (Steam Only)
notes.content: -Add “Fetch Nearby Sites” to the earth browser for Earth Online. This will show nearby takeoff sites from ParaglidingEarth.com. You can then reposition the crosshairs over the takeoff site to takeoff at those coordinates. I may look to make them clickable here in the near future.

notes.title: Update EarlyAccess_2.6.2
notes.content:
-Full screen mode should now match the resolution of your monitor.

notes.title: Update EarlyAccess_2.5.5

notes.title: Update EarlyAccess_2.5.4

notes.title: Update EarlyAccess_2.5.3

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.3.4 - Spectator Cam
notes.content:
-Add the Spectator Cam to glider selection. The spectator cam is “A user-friendly camera that allows you to capture dynamic shots in multiplayer mode or swiftly navigate the map for a comprehensive view.” Much like the drone but easier to control and navigate. 
-Fix force feedback bug with VR hand controllers. 
-Hang glider grip control mode update. Left grip on the VR controllers now enables weight shift with head only, while right grip enables weight shift with hands only. Both grip buttons at the same time enable both hand and head weight shift tracking.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.3.3
notes.content:
-Fix issue with pilot outside of harness in multiplayer hang gliders.
-Fix bug where multiplayer pilot would laydown when first spawned.
-Add compass heading to VR HUD.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.3.2 - Hot Fix
notes.content:
-Fix hang glider from jittering in thermals. 
-Fix hang glider jittering while standing. 
-Slowly place the hang glider on the ground when launched so it doesn’t bounce.  
-Start the hang glider higher up so it doesn’t launch under the ground if placed on uneven ground. 
-Add “Flight Data Overlay / HUD'' in the options menu to display alt, speed, wind and vario in all camera views. 
-Fix double sided shader issues with hang glider harness and vario meter models. 
-Add “Restart on Crash” in the options menu. This will auto restart if you make a hard crash and tumble on terrain or in the trees. 
-You can now press and hold the map or menu button on the VR controllers for 2 seconds to auto restart.  
-Make thermals slightly stronger near the ground.
-Add a slight dead zone to the hang glider grip control mode for force feedback.
-Fix thermals not populating on the south section of Tetons map. 
-Update to Multiplayer 2.2.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.3.1 - Hot Fix
notes.content:
-Make “Force Feedback VR hand Controllers” a setting in the options menu so you can turn off force feedback if you don’t want it. 
-Duplicate options menu to display the same for the in-game options menu so you can now change settings while flying.
-Spruce up options menu UI layout. 
-Make ability to scroll the options menu with gamepad and VR controller thumbstick.
-Fix bug where changing Wind and Thermal Visual Aids in game wouldn’t save settings to disk.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.3.0 - Hot Fix
notes.content:
-Make the grip button less sensitive so as not to accidentally activate it while flying in VR.
-Add force feedback to Grip Mode on hang glider.
-Add input curve to Hang Glider as to make input less sensitive at lower values.
-Make the right click thumbstick on the Xbox controller hide UI.
-Fix bug where Hang Glider pilot would sometimes lay down while running.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.2.9 - Hot Fix
notes.content:

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.2.8 - Hot Fix (Steam Only)

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.2.7 - Hot Fix
notes.content:
-Fix bug where invisible wall would knock you out of the sky. 
-Fix multiplayer issues where you couldn’t restart a flight.
-Fix bug where roads would float above ground. 
-Reduce drag on the hang glider to achieve faster speed when pitching down.
-Add more forward weightshift to hang glider.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.2.6 - Hang Glider!
notes.content:
-Add the new Hang Glider - Falcon 4! 
-Add new external pilot view camera to all gliders. 
-Add more scenery objects near the landing zone on the Swiss Alps map (Thanks Mike!) 
-Add grass target near landing zone on Swiss Alps map (thanks Mike).

-Reduce the strength of thermals near the ground. 
-Clean up small pink spots in tree texture on Sun Valley map.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.2.5 - Hot Fix
notes.content:
-Fix landing pad / pontoon not displaying on Tetons and Swiss Alps map.

-Improve clouds at close range.
-Make it so cloud sprites don’t rotate when directly under the cloud.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.2.4 - Thermals Land Class Sampling
notes.content:
-Add land class sampling to the thermal spawning algorithm. More likely to find thermals over rocky, dirt and gravel areas. Less likely to find thermals over trees. 
-Fix issue where ridgelift would randomly stop all of a sudden. 
-Add rotation clamping to 1st, 3rd person cameras (not in VR or TrackIR).
-Performance improvements. 
-Make tree textures darker.
-Slight brake dampening on Paraglider controls.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.2.2 - XC Race for Sun Valley and Tetons
notes.content:
-Add  XC (Cross Country) Race challenges to the Tetons and Sun Valley Map.
-Make cloud transparency fade in and out.
-Fix leaderboards not displaying grades correctly for countries that use a comma.
-Add “Wind and Thermal Visual aids” options to the in-game settings menu.  
-Make the warning about score not uploading to leaderboards a bit more clear when starting an XC challenge with “Wind and Thermal visual aids” active.  
-Smooth transition in sun direction when there is a time of day change. 
-Adjust weight-shift in the paraglider to not bend the middle of the wing so much. 
-Smooth out weight-shift and zoom input for gamepad and mouse controls.
-Make sunset / sunrise light color more reddish.  
-Some more light and fog adjustments.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.2.1 - Hot Fix (Time Of Day)
notes.content:
-Fix fog colors during time of day to match horizon color. 
-Fix issue where time of day wouldn’t sync when first entering a multiplayer room. 
-Fix missing time of day info on preflight screen and map.
-Fix issue where game could crash after pausing. 
-Remove the cloud shadows option in graphics settings for now. Cloud shadows is too heavily intensive on CPU and the effect is not working properly at long distances.  
-Remove yellow sphere bubbles at close distance when thermal visualization is active.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.2.0 - Time of Day, Thermal System Overhaul, Leaderboard!
notes.content:
-Add Monthly leaderboards to every challenge. 
-Note that scores will not be uploaded to the leaderboard in an XC challenge if you have wind or thermal indicators active… No cheating!
-Add distance markers to XC challenge turn points. 
-Add XC challenge turnpoints on the 2D map. 
-Add landing zone target in XC challenge.
-Each cell of the canopy now receives lift separately from a thermal, so watch if one side of the glider rises then turn into the lift! 
-Adjust turbulence while entering and leaving lift.
-Thermal Activity has been replaced by Time of Day! 
-You can now set Time of Day between 6am and 10pm.
-Time of Day is now synced over multiplayer. 
-Each challenge now has a separate time of day assigned to it.
-Sun sphere is now rendered in the sky, pay attention to its position as it will help you identify where thermals will form. 
-Overhault the thermal system to render thermals and clouds at greater distances. 
-Thermals are now spawned based on time of day and the angle at which the sun is hitting the terrain. You will have heavy thermal activity in the afternoon and light thermal activity near dawn or dusk. 
-Thermals will form on sunward facing slopes and terrain. 
-All clouds now render in 1 draw call! Saving performance. 
-Cloud script only run near user saving performance. 
-Thermals bubble scripts will only run when the user is nearby saving performance. 
-Thermal bubbles are now rendered as circular sprites in 1 draw call when thermal visualization is active, saving performance. 
-Thermal particles will rise faster in the center of a thermal, as well as a darker color.
-Updated thermal particle tails. Center particles will wiggle as they rise. 
-Change cloud color based on time of day. 
-Update to multiplayer v1.8.
-Thermals will now sync exactly between multiplayer users. So if a thermal dies, it will die at exactly the same time for all other users. As well as when thermals form…
-Fix cloud popping in multiplayer. Clouds will no longer just pop out of existence. 
-Thermal bubbles will be smaller near the ground and become bigger at higher altitudes. 
-Recalculate thermals and thermal drift on prewarm when weather changes are made.
-Ridge lift has been expanded further from ridges.  
-Made camera panning / rotating smoother. Especially when using the keyboard / mouse and gamepad controller. 
-UI tweaks and cleanup… 
-Look forward to seeing your scores on the Leaderboard!

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.1.9 - XC Race Prototype!
notes.content:
-Add new XC (Cross Country) Race 1 to Swiss Alps map. (Work in progress. Please provide feedback) 
-Add 2 new speed challenges to Sun Valley.
-Fix speedwing issue with weight shifting at high speeds.
-Add a bit more drag to speedwing landing on ground.
-Gliders will not experience horizontal lift / drag from the character body while doing turns or barrel rolls. Should result in more precise turning at high speeds.
-Lower the height of the gates on speed flying challenge Sun Valley.
-Add weather conditions info to the challenge preflight screen. 
-Fix bug where activity would remain active even after exiting the challenge. 
-Fix bug where it would say you started a challenge instead of launch point. 
-Set thermal activity to 2 for all speed flying challenges so there are some thermals if someone is paragliding in multiplayer.
-Remove landing target from Swiss Alps while in free flight. Landing targets will now only be active in challenge mode.
-Destroy all thermals on thermal settings change. Then repopulate... 
-Adjust thermal drift in wind to be less intense. 
-Increase thermal density some so there are more thermals populating.
-Wind settings will now increment in 5 kph increments instead of 5 mph increments. 
-Update to Multiplayer v1.7
-Fix auto-inflate settings not saving.
-Add industrial park buildings to Swiss Alps map. (Thanks Mike!)
-Add terrain updates to Swiss Alps alps (Thanks Mike).

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.1.8 - Hot Fix
notes.content:

-Make angular drag directly correlated to drag for easier control of speedwing at high speeds.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.1.7 - Hot Fix
notes.content:
-Add 3rd speed flying challenge to Tetons map. 
-Add both ground speed (GS) and Airspeed (AS) to the variometer. 
-Fix issue where “Auto Inflate Canopy” setting was not getting saved.
-Fix issue where all players in multiplayer could act as host starting challenges. 
-Only send “Host started challenge - weather updated accordingly” notification when host starts a challenge and weather has been changed.
-Challenge will now quit / disable if the host changes weather while you're flying a challenge. This ensures cheating can not happen where you could fly with different weather than what the challenge requires. 
-Challenges are locked if the challenge does not match host weather.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.1.6 - Speed Flying Challenges!
notes.content:
-Introducing Scored Challenges! Each map will have a variety of challenges to play both in single player and multiplayer. After completing a challenge you will receive a score + grade. The grades go from A+ to F (fail). In this update we added a couple speed flying challenges, later down the road we will add Paragliding XC challenges, Paramotor challenges and mini-wing challenges. Online leaderboards will also become available at a later date.
-Add 3 speed flying challenges to Swiss Alps, Add 2 speed flying challenges to Tetons, add 1 Speed flying Challenge to Sun Valley. 
-Challenges can be flown in multiplayer but you cannot start one unless the weather is valid, or you are the host. 
-Rename old challenges to lessons. 
-Update home screen UI to square buttons.
-Fix bug where user could start under the platform while launching glider.
-Freeze the body of the user when launching a glider until the intro cam is done playing, and VR calibration is done, so you don’t start drifting down the hill until you are ready.
-Add windsock to the preflight so you can see wind direction at every launch point.
-Increase speedbar input sensitivity some.
-Reduce Anti-Aliasing from 8x to 4x on high settings while in VR to increase performance.
-Add graphics options, Clouds Cast Shadows. (Note shadows will only cast 800 meters out so you will not see cloud shadows unless you are close to the cloud).
-Add floating pontoon to lake in Tetons map.
-Add to the credits: Environmental Artist: Mike Borger! (big thanks to Mike for taking the effort to help. We may have a new dedicated Environmental Artist which is awesome!) 
-Add Mike’s scenery updates to Swiss Alps which includes adding river / dikes, a 3d modeled restaurant, and spruced up terrain around the downtown area.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.1.5
notes.content:

-Update multiplayer to v1.5 (people on multiplayer v1.4 will not be able to play with people on this latest update). 
-Make position visible in multiplayer while in pre-flight, moving around while repositioning the launch point so you can see where your friend is launching from.
-Add “Water Shader High” options to graphics options (Uncheck if you want higher frames). 
-Make stalls more aggressive for paraglider, paramotor and mini-wing. 
-Increase speedbar strength for the paraglider. 
-Fix laser pointer bending in VR while moving with map active.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.1.4
notes.content:

-Add throttle percentage value to the variometer on the Paramotor.

-VR right thumbstick click is now re-center cam.
-Add distance traveled value to variometer for paraglider / mini-wing.

notes.title: Update Early Access_2.1.3

In-Game debug stats.

notes.title: Update: Physics 2.0 Now Live!
notes.content:
In order to achieve the ultimate flying experience its important to get the flight mechanics as real as possible! That's why the last month or two we have been doing research into the best way of doing the physics.  Before we had coded the physics to work fairly well, but we were faking and taking shortcuts with a lot of things. In this new rewrite we do things quite differently. Each cell of the glider obeys aerodynamic calculations of a standard wing and takes into account its weight and surface area. This allows for more complex maneuvers of the glider and more realistic behavior. as each segment has the appropriate lift and drag calculations applied to it. Spirals, wingovers, stalls, and swoops now feel more natural.

Paragliding flight physics is extremely complicated. Much more then just your basic airplane. This method seems to work fairly well, but I am sure we will continue to tweak the physics on later updates. But for now, be sure to give the latest update and try and let us know what you think or any bugs you discover. 

Notice in the video below the first shot you can see the lift and drag forces being applied to each segment of the wing! 
[previewyoutube=m0HoiAIjN68;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 1.4.0 - Major Terrain Rewrite!
notes.content:
The latest update included a massive rewrite to the terrain system! We chose to use a high detailed splatmap solution instead of the satellite imagery. This was a hard decision to make as some details are nice in the satellite imagery but blurry when on the ground. This new solution provides much higher detailed textures at ground level and a cleaner look to the game overall. Although some details are lost when high up compared to the actual satellite imagery. We are also able to have higher grass density over the entire terrain! I look forward to hearing any feedback and what you guys think. Do you like this new solution?

All changes below:
-Use high detailed splatmap textures instead of satellite imagery, this way it looks much better at ground level. Although some details may be lost when high above. 
-Splatmap layout derived from the satellite imagery.
-Add lots of grass, rocks and wind flowers.
-Add grass density to the physics settings.
-Increase shadow distance.
-Grass sways with wind settings.
-Add background nature sound when near ground level.
-Add some cows in the farm field.
-Adjust the mini-wing a speedwing physics to have extended momentum after losing altitude. This way a swoop is easier to achieve. The paraglider and paramotor still have to be updated to the new physics model. 
-Add high detailed 3D roads.
-Make gravel roads flat. 
-Make it so the right joystick on VR controllers can rotate the cameras. 
-Many terrain tweaks.

notes.title: Random Thermals Update

Before the thermals where in fixed positions across the map, and you could predict where one was going to be. To make the gameplay more dynamic thermals now populate randomly across the terrain. Each thermal spawns at a different strength, and when active is forming clouds above it. This makes it a bit more challenging and keeps you on your toes looking for that next big thermal. You can also fly far across the map as the thermals randomly populate around you. In theory you should be able to fly off the map ;) Here is a video of making it to cloud base: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O_p_rHj-sbA

-Make thermals spawn randomly within a 2000 meter radius of the player's position.

notes.title: Glider Sim Update 1.2.9 - Improved Thermals, Ridgelift and more!
notes.content:
This update mainly improves the thermals and ridge lift. The thermals will now provide more lift the more centered you are in the middle. They also grow in size as you get higher. Also clouds only form under active thermals now. 

Ridge lift is a bit more accurate in detecting the lift around you. It also evens out the higher you get so you can't get ridge lift forever up high. 

Other improvements include weight shifting update in VR. It's now based on horizontal head displacement instead of head tilt. Feels a bit more comfortable. Also removed the head in first person mode so it doesn't get in the way. If you need to re-center the camera hit spacebar! 

All changes listed below:
-Mouse wheel zooms camera while in first person mode outside VR. 
-Fix jittering wing while in first person mode. 
-Turn thermal air sound effect down. 
-Thermal lift is now distributed out from the center and no longer a constant value. 
-Make ridge lift more precise and interaction more realistic. 
-Ridge lift now flattens out the higher you go above the ground. 
-More lift during a turn so you don't loose as much altitude.
-More sink while using speed bar.
-Paramotor glide ratio adjusted to be higher with no power applied. 
-Make line renders a bit skinnier. 
-Make clouds only spawn under active thermals.
-Make thermals get bigger as they get higher.
-Fixed issues where glider may turn slightly with no input.
-Make hands maintain the same position while weight shifting. 
-Hide the head like a turtle when in VR first person mode so you can see it and it doesn't get in the way.
-Make hands follow exact vertical movement when using hand controller grip method do they don't stutter.
-Make weight shift based off head offset to left and right instead of head tilt.
-Make a dead zone so if you turn your head in VR you won't get unexpected weight shift.
